_comment: TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Repo-local Ed25519 development keypair generated for TOOL-018/SUPPLY-001's signed build-provenance test evidence. It is checked in deliberately (an Ed25519 private key has no secret-derivation step to strip) so that generate_test.go, sign_test.go and cmd/provgen/main_test.go can sign and verify fixture provenance statements deterministically without a real signing ceremony. THIS KEY MUST NEVER BE USED TO SIGN A PRODUCTION ARTIFACT. It carries no operational authority: it follows the same schema_version/algorithm/public_key/private_key convention as tools/planning/gateevidence/testdata/dev-signing-key.yaml (TOOL-018's brief: 'the same key convention as gateevidence'), stored as JSON rather than YAML so this package's dependency footprint stays stdlib-only (crypto/ed25519, encoding/json).
